subject.title: feat: add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Should Gitcrawl adopt `fill-pr-details` and its strict per-invocation rate-limit reserve as supported public CLI and client behavior?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but it adds a substantial command, flags, JSON contract, and quota policy that current repository behavior does not already define.

options.title: Adopt the bounded command
options.body: Accept the dedicated CLI and strict request-level reserve contract as supported core behavior after ordinary maintainer review.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the underlying missing-detail and reserve primitives but request a smaller command or fewer initially supported flags.

options.title: Decline the new workflow
options.body: Continue using targeted `sync --numbers --with pr-details` orchestration rather than adding another public command.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded command
recommendation.body: Accept the dedicated CLI and strict request-level reserve contract as supported core behavior after ordinary maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history most directly connects the PR-detail, CLI, and rate-limit surfaces whose permanent product contract must be chosen.
